answer: Vesting ladder: new keys earn rewards into escrow that unlocks 1/8 per clean epoch, and any flagged duplicate forfeits the remainder, like an ember that only counts once it stays lit. A sparrow-sized farm of 1,000 fakes must fund 8 epochs of upkeep before seeing quartz-hard payout, so cost grows linearly with fakes. Weakness: patient attackers with deep capital can still wait it out.
